personas.title: Business leaders & first-time builders
personas.style: Browser-first. Describe the outcome, use a builder and validate the result in plain language.
personas.needs: An owned builder account, available build credits and an explicitly selected app AI/backend option. No terminal is required for this route.

flows.goal: A functional incident inbox and one real AI investigation.
steps: Describe the operator and payments incident in one sentence; choose one builder and confirm available credits.
Paste the app definition. Click create, search, filter and select; ask the builder to fix one actual usability issue.
Use an explicitly selected managed AI option or a supported private server integration. Add keys only through its server-side secret UI, never the project chat.
Click Analyze safely on the selected ticket. Require a real answer with actual evidence, then verify loading and failure messages.
flows.prompt: Extend our existing OpsDesk app for Part 1: A functional incident inbox and one real AI investigation. Follow this No IT knowledge / C-level learner route. Explain the next action in plain language and use the builder UI; do not require me to run terminal commands. Implement backend checks in code, not just in a prompt. Use synthetic data and my explicitly selected backend. Never invent a successful answer, usage or trace. Keep keys in server secrets. Do not publish, buy credits, activate cloud services or change permissions without specific authority. Complete the route actions, verify actual results and report blockers honestly.
finish: Create, search, filter and select an invented ticket in the actual app.
Analyze the selected ticket using a real configured model and at least one permitted tool; display the actual answer.
Show loading, busy and failure states without fake AI success, browser keys or automatic retries.
Restart the app using documented commands and reproduce the core journey. Persistence beyond the documented memory lifetime is not required.
flows.help: If access, credentials or native model support are missing, preserve the working app and mark that acceptance checkpoint blocked. A local model-double test or static preview is not a real app/model/provider result.
